meals.name: Kefir & Blueberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Avocado
meals.image_prompt: overhead photo of two fried eggs on toasted sourdough bread topped with sliced avocado beside a tall glass of purple blueberry kefir smoothie, natural morning light, wooden table
day_of_steps: Pour 250 ml kefir into a blender with 80 g (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) frozen blueberries; blend 30 seconds until smooth; pour into a tall glass.
Toast 40 g (Diego) / 30 g (Diana) sourdough bread in the toaster until golden.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat; add ½ tsp olive oil; crack 2 eggs (Diego) / 2 eggs (Diana) into the pan; fry 2–3 minutes until whites are set but yolks still soft.
Slide eggs onto toast; top with ¼ avocado (35 g) sliced (same for both); season with black pepper and a pinch of sea salt.
Serve smoothie alongside. Drink 500 ml water.

Weigh out 25 g (Diego) / 20 g (Diana) whole almonds into a small bowl.

meals.name: Mediterranean Beef & Lentil Bowl with Roasted Bell Peppers & Quinoa
meals.image_prompt: overhead food photo of a bowl with seasoned ground beef, green lentils, roasted red and yellow bell pepper strips, fluffy quinoa, drizzled with olive oil, natural light, rustic ceramic bowl
prep_steps: Sunday: cook 300 g dry quinoa in 600 ml salted water; cool and portion into airtight containers — store fridge.
Sunday: drain and rinse 2 cans (800 g) green lentils; season with cumin, oregano, salt; store fridge.
Sunday: roast bell peppers — slice 4 bell peppers into strips, toss with olive oil, paprika, salt; roast at 200 °C for 25 min; cool and store fridge.
Sunday: brown 600 g beef mince with garlic, cumin, paprika, oregano, salt; cool and store fridge.
day_of_steps: Reheat 130 g (Diego) / 90 g (Diana) cooked quinoa in microwave 90 seconds; fluff with a fork.
Reheat 130 g (Diego) / 100 g (Diana) browned beef in a pan over medium heat 3–4 minutes.
Reheat 80 g (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) lentils in the same pan 1–2 minutes.
Warm 100 g (Diego) / 80 g (Diana) roasted bell pepper strips in microwave 45 seconds.
Assemble bowl: quinoa base, then lentils, beef, bell peppers on top.
Drizzle 2 tsp olive oil and a splash of balsamic vinegar over bowl; season with black pepper.
Serve with 1 peach (Diego & Diana) on the side. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Soy-Ginger Baked Salmon with Stir-Fried Zucchini & Spinach on Sourdough
meals.image_prompt: a plate with a glazed soy-ginger salmon fillet beside sautéed zucchini and wilted spinach, served with a slice of toasted sourdough, steam rising, natural evening light, white plate
day_of_steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C. Mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, ½ tsp ginger powder, 1 tsp garlic powder in a bowl.
Place 180 g (Diego) / 140 g (Diana) salmon fillets on a lined baking tray; brush generously with soy-ginger glaze.
Bake 12–15 minutes until salmon flakes easily.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick pan; add 1 clove minced garlic; stir-fry 150 g sliced zucchini (same for both) for 3 minutes.
Add 80 g baby spinach to the pan; toss until wilted, about 1 minute; season with black pepper.
Toast 40 g (Diego) / 30 g (Diana) sourdough bread.
Plate: stir-fried veg first, salmon on top; serve sourdough on the side.
Arrange 80 g cherry tomatoes (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) on the side as raw veg. Drink 500 ml water.

Drink 500 ml water.
